payload.expected: The prescribed artifact-durability helper would inspect every cited local artifact.
payload.observed: The helper exited 2 with spawnSync git EPERM.
payload.consequence: Publication required the documented per-path Git fallback before staging.
payload.workaround_taken: Ran per-path Git checks proving each artifact tracked, clean, visible at origin/main, and byte-identical.

payload.expected: The approved two-child family and browser checklist run sheet validate against the frozen acceptance criteria before tracker mutation.
payload.observed: Initial run-sheet validation failed composite checklist coverage for both slices, requiring staged acceptance-wording and exact-excerpt revisions plus validator reruns before publication.
payload.consequence: Publication required two validation correction passes; no invalid child issue or ledger was published.
payload.workaround_taken: Revised only the staged acceptance wording and run-sheet excerpts, then reran the canonical validators before each tracker write.

payload.expected: The final family verifier can consume one approved publication manifest covering the standalone-source predecessor and the three PRD #195 children without misrepresenting their relationships.
payload.observed: The verifier required exactly one relationship mode for every issue in a manifest, so it could not verify the standalone-source issue and parented children together.
payload.consequence: Final proof required separate 1-issue and 3-issue manifests, split run sheets, and split working ledgers in addition to the validated four-entry publication ledger.
payload.workaround_taken: Ran two exact non-overlapping relationship-homogeneous manifests and combined their verified 1-of-1 and 3-of-3 results as the approved 4-of-4 publication proof.
